QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired too. The same vector means three different things.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the tokenizer returns `{}` on failure and the backend wrapper returns the same `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, so callers can't tell them apart.
